name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
lane=Path('.').resolve()
after=json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text()); assert after['count']==185 and not after['mismatches']
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='085f3486f06984927041a069774f4cc449c551542e549c0e948539d30ed4747d'
excluded=['SHA256-MANIFEST.json','seal_manifest.receipt.json','seal_manifest.output.txt']
files={}
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(lane)) not in excluded:
  assert not p.is_symlink()
  files[str(p.relative_to(lane))]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
completed=[n for n in files if n.endswith('.receipt.json') or n=='bootstrap-receipt.json']
assert 'get_weighted_prior.receipt.json' in completed and 'inspect_inputs.receipt.json' in completed and 'write_inventories.receipt.json' in completed
m={'mathdb_id':339209,'reservation_sha256':'085f3486f06984927041a069774f4cc449c551542e549c0e948539d30ed4747d','files':files,'every_completed_receipt_json':completed,'terminal_self_exclusions':{'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'manifest cannot include its own final digest','seal_manifest.receipt.json':'runner emits terminal receipt only after this child exits','seal_manifest.output.txt':'runner emits terminal output only after this child exits'},'frozen_after':after,'scope':'Own lane files only; no symlinks or protected path traversal;151author references hash-only via standalone frozen verifier','acceptance':'NOT_ACCEPTED','credit':0}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','SHA256-MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(m,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
for n,h in files.items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'completed_receipts_hashed':len(completed),'terminal_self_exclusions':excluded,'frozen_count':after['count'],'frozen_mismatches':after['mismatches'],'verdict':'FULL_EQUIVALENCE_ORDINARY_PASS_QUALIFICATION_HOLDS_CREDIT0'}))
